g.text: Sign-in, lockout, JWT access token and rotating refresh token
30 / 15 min per IP and 10 / 15 min per IP+account
reject if CSRF header missing or Origin is foreign
scrypt verify against a dummy hash
reset counters, INSERT activity "Student Logged In"
INSERT auth_session (sha256(refresh token), expires 8 h / 30 d)
Set-Cookie uit_at = JWT 15 min (httpOnly, Strict, path /api)
verify JWT (HS256, iss, aud, exp) — no DB call
isSessionActive(sid) (30 s cache, DB on miss)
POST /api/auth/refresh (cookie uit_rt) — one request shared by all callers
compare-and-set: new hash, remember previous hash
new uit_at + rotated uit_rt, original call replayed
